methods.label: Last child's allocation
methods.explanation: There are \(3x+5\) candies in total. The last child receives \(3x+5-4(x-1)=9-x\) candies. Thus, \(1\leq9-x<4\), giving \(5<x\leq8\), so the maximum value of \(x\) is 8.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 allocation modeling and linear inequalities; the allowed upper endpoint is itself an integer.
